mission.title: We bridge academic theory and industry practice.
mission.p1: Albert LIGHT (Lab of Intelligent, Generative, Hands-on Technology) is the student association for AI and software development at Albert School.
mission.p2: We are a collaborative launchpad for students who want to go beyond the classroom: members build portfolio-ready AI projects, master the developer tools used in industry and work alongside experienced peers and real professionals.
mission.p3: Beginners are welcome; experienced developers find challenges worth their time.
